item.title: Version 1.2
item.description:
• Updates itself now: Clean My Crap checks for new versions and installs them for you (Clean My Crap → Check for Updates…)
  • Send Feedback from the Help menu
  • Evict an App: drop an app on the window or the Dock icon and it leaves with all its crap
  • Apps You Forgot You Had, and Ghosts of Apps Past (leftovers of apps you already deleted)
  • The crap command-line tool (Clean My Crap → Install Command Line Tool…)
  • Feels more like a Mac app: instant switching, results appear while scanning, flushing in a sheet
